items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-06-15
items.q: I could tell you some of the persons in the band at home when I was a kid.

ctx.x: It was Chris from Magnolia or Derang? From Derang. He's from Derang.

Yeah. Now, I could tell you some of the persons in the band at home when I was a kid. Let me see. Walter Johnson, bass. Let me see. Alec Taylor, trumpet. Ben Cole, trumpet. Boyle Stevenson, trumpet. Boyle Stevenson, trumpet. Boyle Stevenson, trumpet. Weaver Jason, trumpet. William Stevenson, trumpet. Dan Sparks, alto. John Cole. Who was a solo alto. Joe Granson, baritone. I was a solo alto. He was a solo alto, Joe Granson, baritone, Robert Cooper.
The tape ran off on the first reel. This is the second reel we're doing now of you and Jim Robinson. You were saying something about a fellow named Dee Dee just on the tape.

items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-07-13
items.q: Oh, he was the musician for my home, you see?

ctx.x: You remember a lot of things, too.

Yeah. Sure. Who is this Joe Granson or something like that? Joe Granson? Yeah, Granson. Oh, he was the musician for my home, you see? He used to be a trombone player, baritone player. Yeah, he's good trombone player and baritone player, too. He's a good musician. Well, that's one of the fellas Old Man Humphrey taught. Jim Humphrey. Poise Humphrey's granddaddy taught. That's one of the fellas he taught, you see? Jim Humphrey. Old Man Humphrey, he turned out some good musicians from that low course. Good musicians.…
